text:
mara: Kicking off a short thread on the fallback UX: we need to agree how evidence is scored and displayed in the rollout console. Current issue: operators see a single ‘triggered’ badge but not the strength or provenance.

eli: We should show a composite score that combines metric deltas, sample failure rate, and recent config changes. Call it `fallback_evidence_score` 0..1.

sam: UX: show the breakdown next to the badge, e.g. `0.78 = 0.5(metric)+0.2(samples)+0.08(deploy)`. Small sparkline of the metric window.

jon: From implementation: we need predictable aggregation windows. Propose 1m/5m/30m buckets and an exp-decay for older signals. Document in editor tooltip.

viv: Also surface whether evidence is direct (sampled request hit predicate) vs indirect (downstream telemetry). Different color treatments in the UI.

ravi: Important: show cost impact estimate when fallback runs (tokens delta, p99 latency change). Operators care about unit economics.

mara: Agreed. Add `estimated_cost_delta` and `latency_delta_estimate` to each audit entry. Keep them lightweight.

ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Updated canary rules applied to fleet-west at 2025-04-02T14:11:10Z :white_check_mark:

eli: For scoring rules, propose a simple weighted sum config in the policy:
```yaml
evidence_weights:
  metric_delta: 0.6
  sample_fail_rate: 0.3
  recent_deploy: 0.1
aggregation_window: 5m
decay_half_life: 15m
thresholds:
  soft: 0.45
  hard: 0.75
```

sam: UX nuance: thresholds should be annotated with expected action & recommended follow-up. e.g., soft -> "auto-route, monitor 10m". hard -> "halt rollout, page SRE".

jon: Telemetry-wise, we must ensure the console can explain which metric contributed most. Include top-3 contributing signals in the audit row.

viv: Can we show a small list of representative sampled traces (max 5) and a single synthesized example that highlights the failure class? The synth must be clearly labeled.

ravi: On retention: artifacts (traces + synths) TTL 14 days by default, configurable up to 90d for enterprise. Also add storage size budget per org.

mara: RBAC: SRE+rollout-owner = full artifact view. Others see sanitized summary. Log who accessed artifacts and when.

eli: Edge case: overlapping signals from independent customers on shared infra. Audit entries should include `scope` (customer|shared|global). Don't attribute global infra to a single rollout.

sam: Rollback automation: allow a policy to auto-rollback if `fallback_evidence_score` > hard threshold for >= X minutes AND `flapping`==false. But if flips back and forth, require manual.

jon: Define flapping detection: count transitions primary<->fallback over sliding 10m window; if >3, mark flapping and suppress auto-rollback. UI shows reason.

viv: Drift detection idea: run golden-prompt checks in the background every 1H and surface drift score as an additional signal that increases weight for model-quality issues.

ravi: For cost accounting: capture token delta per 1000 requests when measuring. Show rough monthly projection if policy stays.

mara: Small governance: every reclassification (manual override of root cause) must be an auditable comment with user and reason; original evidence fields remain.

ops-bot: [incident-bot] Alert ROLLOUT-512: evidence_score exceeded 0.75 for canary-west for 12m (auto-rollback candidate).

eli: Action items:
- eli: propose JSON audit entry shape with the evidence breakdown (today)
- jon: add decay semantics and promql + query examples (tomorrow)
- sam: mockups for badge + breakdown + sampled traces (prototype next week)
- viv: sketch golden-prompt integration + retention policy (end of week)

mara: Thanks. Please drop any sample synths and a few redacted traces in #eng-platform-uploads with tag `evidence-samples`. We will gate the spike on those.

sam: +1

jon: +1

viv: +1

ravi: +1
